title: Implement fixture-only retention lifecycle control composition
businessObjective: Prove that configured retention can be evaluated and composed without deleting production records, selecting a storage provider, or rewriting audit history.
technicalObjective: Implement a small retention lifecycle control boundary with local/reference fixtures only. It consumes P2-006 retention authorities and P2-007 capacity decisions to produce scheduled delete, aggregate, archive, or transfer-eligibility instructions; it performs no deletion, archival, transfer, provisioning, network call, or local-storage write.
assumptions: P2-006 remains the retention-category and protected-evidence authority; P3-005 does not reinterpret it.
All inputs, clocks, schedules, records, and adapter responses are deterministic fixtures/reference objects.
A later separately approved task is required for any storage-provider adapter, scheduled job, deletion, archival, transfer, data copy, or production configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: A deep lifecycle boundary accepts only classified, retention-authorized fixture records and returns one deterministic non-authoritative instruction: scheduled delete, aggregate, archive, transfer eligible, retain, or fail-closed block.

It defines and tests due/not-due schedule evaluation, aggregation-before-disposition, protected audit/failed-attempt preservation, archival eligibility, and future local-transfer eligibility without performing any lifecycle action.

Unknown category, missing authority, unsupported action, malformed record, missing/unavailable/stale/inconsistent/uncertain capacity input, or conflicting retention/audit rule fails closed with a deterministic reason.

Composition remains adapter-only: core/domain code imports no provider, database, filesystem, queue, scheduler, or local-server SDK and cannot delete, archive, transfer, provision, or write local storage.

Deterministic fixture tests cover every instruction and negative path, prove no fixture creates a per-click lifecycle record or AI invocation, and record that no production deletion, local transfer, or provisioning occurred.
requiredChecks: exact validator admission before independent verification
hexagonal import-boundary and fail-closed capacity review
solEscalationTriggers: Any actual deletion, archival, transfer, local storage write, provider configuration, scheduled service, audit-retention ambiguity, or production-data access.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only the local/reference composition, tests, documentation, evidence, and packet state. Preserve all historical evidence and perform no external lifecycle action.
